create_channel_stats_collector: create a ChannelStatsCollector instance to track communication statistics for client-to-server and server-to-client directions
collect_channel_stats: collect message size statistics by calling collect_channel_stats with a byte count and direction flag
reset_channel_stats: reset all communication statistics to fresh RandomVariableStatsTracker instances for both channel directions
get_channel_stats: get the current communication stats dictionary keyed by ChannelDirection enum values
use_channel_direction_enum: use the ChannelDirection enum with CLIENT_TO_SERVER or SERVER_TO_CLIENT values to identify communication direction
